concepts.gloss_en: revelation of the aspect of Y-H (the divine name spelled yud-heh)
revelation of the aspect of the Name of Hashem (day after Yom Kippur, distinct construct head from Y-H)

notes: Different construct heads: י"ה (yud-heh divine name) vs שם ה' (the Name of Hashem). Distinct referents in distinct Torahs (lm1:77 vs lm2:66). Kept separate per rule 4.
